name: Blackblade
description: The Blackblade is a mystical soul-drinking sword forged by Dakkon, later wielded by Gideon Jura against Belzenlok, Rhonas and Nicol Bolas before it shattered.

description_citations.text: "Blackblade". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

summary.text: The Blackblade is a mystical soul-drinking sword forged by Dakkon, later wielded by Gideon Jura against Belzenlok, Rhonas and Nicol Bolas before it shattered.

citations.text: "Blackblade". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Dakkon forged it for Geyadrone Dihada at her urging, sacrificing his own blood, then his son, then countless slaves, and Dihada then stabbed it into his shadow to bind his soul into the blade.

citations.text: "Blackblade", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Blackblade", section "Geyadrone's plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Dakkon Blackblade", section "Forging the Blackblade". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Dakkon used it to kill Piru, creating the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.

citations.text: "Blackblade", section "Geyadrone's plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Around 4560 AR it came into the hands of the Cabal minion Needle, and the Cabal rewrote its origins.

citations.text: "Blackblade", section "Reforged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Gideon stole it from the Cabal vaults and lodged it in Belzenlok's leg, and Liliana then used it to drain Belzenlok's life and kill him.

citations.text: "Blackblade", section "Reforged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

bio.text: In the War of the Spark Gideon stabbed the God-Eternal Rhonas with it, draining him to dust.

citations.text: "Blackblade", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Gideon struck Bolas's head with it, but it broke because Bolas had enchanted it to never hurt another elder dragon.

citations.text: "Blackblade", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: The Blackblade shattered against Bolas during the War of the Spark, and no later story shows it restored.

citations.text: "Blackblade", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon forges the Blackblade, sacrificing his own blood, then his son Daron, then countless slaves over the following years.
timeline.quote: Dakkon plunged the white-hot metal into his own son's chest.

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geyadrone receives the Blackblade and steals Dakkon's soul by stabbing his shadow with the sword.
timeline.quote: she stabbed Dakkon's shadow on the ground, treacherously stealing his soul with the sword

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Geyadrone's plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon stabs Piru with the Blackblade, killing her; the blast creates the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor and Dihada absorbs Piru's soul power.
timeline.quote: he stabbed Piru with the Blackblade, killing her.

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Geyadrone's plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dihada binds Dakkon to her will and he travels to Terisiare with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: Dihada managed to "tag" Dakkon, binding him to her will.

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Geyadrone's plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Around 4560 AR the Blackblade comes into the possession of the Cabal minion Needle, and the Cabal rewrites its origins.
timeline.quote: would come into the possession of the Cabal minion Needle

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Reforged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon steals the Blackblade from the Cabal vaults and confronts Belzenlok; Liliana's taunting lets Gideon lodge it in the demon's leg and Liliana activates its curse, draining Belzenlok's soul.
timeline.quote: Liliana grasped its hilt and activated its curse, draining Belzenlok's soul

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Reforged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dihada offers to make Dakkon a planeswalker if he forges the Blackblade, and he forges it over ten years, killing a slave with it each time.
timeline.quote: offered to make him a planeswalker if he would make her the most powerful blade in existence, the Blackblade .

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Forging the Blackblade". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon becomes Dakkon Blackblade through his slaughter; Dihada ignites his spark but stabs the sword into his shadow and binds his soul into the blade.
timeline.quote: she stabbed the sword into Dakkon's shadow and absorbed his soul but not his life.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Forging the Blackblade". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dihada has Dakkon forge the Blackblade, then triggers his spark and absorbs his soul into it.
timeline.quote: but then she used the Blackblade to absorb his shadow and his soul into the blade.

citation.text: "Geyadrone Dihada", section "Dihada's schemes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jhoira explains the Blackblade killed an elder dragon.
timeline.quote: It killed an elder dragon.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira describes the Blackblade as a soul-drinker made with death magic.
timeline.quote: But it's a soul-drinker, created with death magic, and steals the life-energy of everyone it kills.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon refuses to use a soul-drinker under any circumstances.
timeline.quote: A soul-drinker is not something we would want to use, under any circumstances.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna notes the Blackblade is locked in the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: It's also locked up in the Stronghold,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Liliana defeat Belzenlok on Dominaria, with Gideon killing him using the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: which he ultimately used to kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew learns of the Blackblade, planeswalkers reinforce them, and Jhoira returns Teferi's spark powerstone to him; they fight Yargle at the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Jhoira finally found the right moment to hand over the powerstone containing Teferi's spark to its rightful owner

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Fighting Belzenlok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok is killed with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: together they managed to kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Return to Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Liliana, Jaya and Chandra discuss killing Belzenlok without the Chain Veil, and Liliana raises using the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: It's a sword that slew an elder dragon, and Gideon is too delicate to allow us to use it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon agrees to use the Blackblade if it can be found in Belzenlok's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: If we can find it in the Stronghold, I'll use it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Chandra and Radha find the Blackblade in the fourth treasury vault and fight through the Stronghold's hall as the undead overwhelm the Cabal.
timeline.quote: They had found the weapon inside the fourth treasury vault, mounted on a stone plinth like a trophy.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon draws the Blackblade and confronts Belzenlok outside the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Gideon took a deep breath and drew the Blackblade.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok knocks Gideon down, but the Blackblade pierces his thigh and Liliana grabs the hilt.
timeline.quote: Liliana leapt forward, under Belzenlok's arm, and seized the Blackblade's hilt.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana drains Belzenlok's life with the Blackblade and kills him; his body collapses into lumps of flesh.
timeline.quote: What was left of Belzenlok collapsed into lumps of white flesh.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Oketra's shot pierces Gideon's pegasus and Gideon tumbles through the air with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: Gideon tumbled through the air, Blackblade in hand.

citation.text: Divine Arrow (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon stabs Rhonas in the eye with the Blackblade, draining the God-Eternal to dust.
timeline.quote: Gideon stabbed him in the eye with the Blackblade

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon strikes Bolas's head with the Blackblade but it breaks; Bolas reveals he had enchanted it to never hurt another elder dragon.
timeline.quote: the sword broke against its flesh

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills the God-Eternal Rhonas with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: Gideon was able to kill the god, stabbing him in the eye with the Blackblade and draining his essence

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon strikes Bolas with the Blackblade, but it breaks against the dragon's flesh.
timeline.quote: He struck Bolas in the head with Blackblade, but the sword broke against the dragon's flesh

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills the God-Eternal Rhonas with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: Gideon was able to kill the god, stabbing him in the eye with Blackblade and draining his essence.

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon strikes Bolas with the Blackblade, but it breaks against the dragon.
timeline.quote: He struck Bolas in the head with Blackblade, but the sword broke against the dragon's flesh

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakdos brings Gideon within striking distance but is knocked out, and Gideon's Blackblade shatters against Bolas, who had enchanted it.
timeline.quote: Bolas reveals he enchanted the Blackblade thousands of years ago, preventing it from being able to harm an elder dragon again.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon, encouraged by Ajani's reminder of the Oath, vows to retake Ravnica with Blackblade and the crowd gathers around him.
timeline.quote: With it, I hereby vow to take back this world. Who's with me?

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Dakkon forges the Blackblade for Geyadrone Dihada and unwittingly becomes part of her schemes.
timeline.quote: As Dakkon forged the Blackblade for Geyadrone Dihada, he unwittingly forged himself into her schemes.

citation.text: Profane Tutor (Modern Horizons 2, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura uses the Blackblade against Bolas, but it breaks against his flesh.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Gideon Jura used the Blackblade to attack Nicol Bolas , but the sword broke against the Elder Dragon's flesh.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Blackblade reforged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura infiltrated the Stronghold and seized the Blackblade while the Weatherlight and crew struck.
timeline.quote: The Planeswalker Gideon Jura infiltrated the Stronghold and seized control of the Blackblade

citation.text: "Belzenlok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess used the Blackblade to slay Belzenlok and end his reign.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess used the legendary sword to slay Belzenlok and end his reign

citation.text: "Belzenlok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon attempts to slay Bolas with the Blackblade; the attack fails and the weapon shatters.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura later made a desperate attempt to slay Bolas using the Blackblade

citation.text: "Bolas's Citadel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The boy recovers the Blackblade and passes it to Dakkon, who uses it to kill Piru.
timeline.quote: Dakkon used the blade to kill Piru.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon sends Rhuell away and kills Piru with the Blackblade, creating the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.
timeline.quote: Piru then fought him but was killed when Dakkon stabbed her with the Blackblade

citation.text: "Piru", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura destroys Rhonas with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: he was finally destroyed by Gideon Jura , who struck him down with the Blackblade

citation.text: "Rhonas", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geyadrone Dihada corrupts Sol'Kanar, making the poppies disappear, then sets the Forging of the Blackblade in action.
timeline.quote: Geyadrone Dihada showed up on Dominaria and corrupted Sol'Kanar

citation.text: "Sivitri's War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
